clinical_program_completion.required_vs_present_summary: The Clinical Program panel now surfaces BOTH the three-room proof (Uptake + Injection + PET/CT) and the full basic PET department required-vs-present summary (adds Radiopharmacy). Informational only; never auto-adds a room.
clinical_program_completion.completion_semantics: COMPLETENESS_IS_INFORMATIONAL; the actual assigned program depends on the user's assignments in the active iModel.

automatic_connectivity_doctrine.section_42_record_doctrine: The normal workflow is SIMULATE -> infer missions -> eligible modes -> auto-generate connections.
automatic_connectivity_doctrine.manual_override: reserved for a future What-If / Engineering-Override; NOT implemented in Build 1B
automatic_connectivity_doctrine.build_1b_scope: Build 1B binds equipment/resources to BIM rooms spatially and records the transport-endpoint spatial authority; it does NOT generate routes, run simulation, or run the optimizer.
automatic_connectivity_doctrine.transport_endpoint_spatial_authority: getMrtFacilitySpatialAuthority(class) returns the canonical MRT facility spatial class + cost-authority reference by reference (vestibule / endpoint); no route is created.
